workflow.name: Brand Extraction (Web Browse)
workflow.description: Text Input -> Web Browse -> Prompt Template -> LLM (extract brand name / logo URL / colors / font / tagline as JSON) -> Output Parser -> Output. Fetches a website with a real headless browser so JS-rendered pages work, then asks the LLM to extract structured branding data from the page title, meta tags, image URLs and text. The model does not see the screenshot or the page's CSS, so it reports colors and fonts only when the page data states them. A user_prompt sent with the run replaces the inline URL.
